approaches.title: Assessment and diagnosis
approaches.copy: A thorough, hands-on assessment of how you move, where you're restricted, and what's likely driving your symptoms — explained in plain English at your first visit.
approaches.whoItHelps: Every new patient, and anyone returning after a change in their symptoms.

approaches.title: Manual therapy
approaches.copy: Hands-on techniques — joint mobilisation, soft-tissue work and stretching — used to ease pain and restore movement.
approaches.whoItHelps: Stiff joints, tight muscles, and the early, most uncomfortable stage of many injuries.

approaches.title: Exercise-based rehabilitation
approaches.copy: A structured, progressive exercise programme built around your goals, taught in clinic and practised at home.
approaches.whoItHelps: Building lasting strength and resilience — the core of most rehab plans here.

approaches.title: Acupuncture
approaches.copy: Fine needles used alongside other treatment to help settle pain and muscle tension.
approaches.whoItHelps: People who find it eases muscular pain as part of a wider treatment plan.

approaches.title: Sports massage
approaches.copy: Focused soft-tissue massage to ease muscle tightness, aid recovery and support training load.
approaches.whoItHelps: Athletes managing training load, and anyone with tight, overworked muscles.
